notes.title: A peek at the upcoming Update + Autumn Sale!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of Let Them Trade! We're so very happy to see you having fun with the game and getting your feedback here and on our discord <3[/p][p][/p][p]The team is back in their groove and working tirelessly to bring you a new update soon - so today we wanted to share a little snippet of what you can expect when it drops![/p][p][/p][p][b]New resources and research tree changes![/b][/p][p]We are reworking the research tree and the production chains. New resources got added to make the middle to late game more interesting. Accompaning that are new buildings and icons for the new resources.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Visual variety![/b][/p][p]We're introducing tile variations for some tile types, like different forests.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Bounty System![/b][/p][p]Cities will place a bounty on the bandits who stole their goods. Players will be able to collect the bounty after capturing the bandit.[/p][p]Also a lot of smaller improvements in regards to the bandits.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Smarter Transporters![/b][/p][p]Inner-city transporters will be able to work more efficiently. They are able to transport multiple resources and do multiple tasks at once. They try to combine different routes for different resources and to avoid travelling empty when there is something on their way they can pick up. They also prioritize the resources they need to transport differently. And loading/unloading times are now influenced by how much they carry. (that was a fixed time till now) The UI now reflects how much a transporter is transporting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Performance optimisations![/b][/p][p]Reworking our rendering to be much more stable and produce less visual artifacts. Lower-end systems should get more frames now and everyone should experience less crashes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balancing![/b][/p][p]Rebalanced the economy[/p][p]Added new modifications[/p][p]Increased input and output capacities[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quality-of-life changes![/b][/p][p]Redid the general resource overview in the top left to be much clearer[/p][p]Quickly access "donate" and "collect" buttons by pressing and holding the "Shift" key[/p][p]Lots of smaller bug fixes and tweaks[/p][p][/p][p]We'll post a more detailed changelog once the update is out![/p][p]Until then, owners of Let Them Trade can hop on the Discord to try out some of the new changes now![/p][p][/p][p]One more thing - Let Them Trade will participate in [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b] next week, so if you're looking to get the game with a nice discount now's your chance![/p][p][/p][p]See you soon and happy trading![/p]

tags.feature: New resources and research tree changes!
New resources got added to make the middle to late game more interesting.
Accompaning that are new buildings and icons for the new resources.
We're introducing tile variations for some tile types, like different forests.
New Bounty System!
Cities will place a bounty on the bandits who stole their goods.
Players will be able to collect the bounty after capturing the bandit.
Inner-city transporters will be able to work more efficiently.
They are able to transport multiple resources and do multiple tasks at once.
They try to combine different routes for different resources and to avoid travelling empty when there is something on their way they can pick up.
They also prioritize the resources they need to transport differently.
And loading/unloading times are now influenced by how much they carry.
The UI now reflects how much a transporter is transporting.
Added new modifications
Redid the general resource overview in the top left to be much clearer
Quickly access "donate" and "collect" buttons by pressing and holding the "Shift" key

tags.bug: Reworking our rendering to be much more stable and produce less visual artifacts.
Lower-end systems should get more frames now and everyone should experience less crashes.
Lots of smaller bug fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Dev-Diary: Trader Models and Pathfinding
notes.content:
[h1]We've thrown out another placeholder![/h1]
The next placeholder had to go and was kicked out, this time it was [b]the trader's[/b].
We replaced the flying "somethings" with an actual model of how the traders are supposed to look in the game - a carriage with brave horsies in front of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853833/58d6b0a310631256cc64f881bf68719393af43d7.png[/img]

They also rotate into the proper direction, so they'll see and be able to avoid any obstacles in their way.

Speaking of obstacles:

[h1]Base Pathfinding Implementation[/h1]

We also have a working pathfinding implementation now.
What is that and what does this mean, you ask?

It's the ability of the game to find a decent way from one hexagonal tile of the map to any other - including accounting for hard to pass terrain or not all passable fields.

Check out this example, where the game found a neat way from the left to the right end of this road while avoiding and "walking around" the impassable mountains:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853833/bf08dba294f1801f10739e409dec607f16f186c4.png[/img]


So yah, all in all, we're coming along nicely,
stay tuned for more updates - and the closed Early Alpha soon!

[i][b]-Your Spaceflower Team[/b][/i]
